text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond took 1st place in the Osaka 
Hai. The crowd was in awe of the sheer 
beauty of her running.

In the stands, Mejiro McQueen and Tokai 
Teio were also watching the race unfold.

Despite her frustration, Kitasan Black 
still wished to run together with her 
again.

Satono Diamond felt the exact same way. 
The two promised to face each other once 
more in the Tenno Sho (Spring).
